title: Galette des Rois with Almond Cream
summary: Two rounds of buttery puff pastry sealed around a rich almond cream, scored in a sunburst pattern and baked until deep golden.
equipment: 23 cm plate or cake tin, as a template

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt
large egg, separated (white for the cream, yolk for the glaze)
all-butter puff pastry (2 x 320 g sheets), chilled
whole blanched almond, for the charm (optional)

steps.title: Almond cream
steps.text: beat the butter and icing sugar until creamy, then the ground almonds, flour and salt. Beat in the whole egg, then the egg white, then the vanilla and almond flavouring. Cover and chill 1 h. Mix the yolk with the water for the glaze and chill.

steps.title: Cut
steps.text: using the plate, cut a 23 cm round from each pastry sheet and put one on the lined tray.

steps.title: Fill
steps.text: spread the almond cream over the base, leaving a 2.5 cm border, and press in the almond if using. Brush the border with water, lay the second round on top and press the edges firmly to seal. Scallop the edge with the back of a knife and chill 30 min. A firm seal stops the almond cream leaking as it bakes.

steps.title: Decorate
steps.text: heat the oven to 220 °C (200 °C fan). Brush the top thinly with the yolk glaze, keeping it off the cut edge, then score curved lines from the centre outwards with the knife tip without cutting through, and make 5 small steam holes. Glaze on the cut edge glues the layers and stops them rising.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: lower the oven to 200 °C (180 °C fan) and bake 30-40 min until puffed and deep golden, covering loosely with foil if it browns too fast. The almond cream should be set and reach 75 °C.

steps.title: Cool
steps.text: cool on the rack 15 min and serve warm or at room temperature, warning guests about the hidden almond.

tips: A common mistake is cutting right through the pastry when scoring; press lightly with the tip.
Keep everything cold so the layers rise high.
Tell everyone about the hidden almond before they bite.
safety: Don't taste the raw dough or batter: raw flour and raw egg aren't safe to eat until baked.
storage: Best on the day. Keep covered at room temperature for 1 day or in the fridge for 2 days, and warm at 160 °C (140 °C fan) for 10 min.
